## 1. Learn route screen — module list rendering

### Primary learn route (list of all courses/modules)
- **File:** `/workspaces/learn-p5/src/app/learn/index.tsx`
- Renders a `FlatList` of courses (`orderedCourses`) at lines 84–129.
- Per-item render (lines 96–113) wraps a single `ExerciseCard` in a `cardWrapper` View:
  ```tsx
  <ExerciseCard
    title={item.title}
    moduleName={item.moduleName}
    description={`${item.exercises.length} exercises · ${item.description}`}
    locked={locked}
    completed={completed}
    isCurrent={isCurrent}
    onContinue={() => router.push(`/learn/${item.slug}`)}
  />
  ```
- The list reorders courses so active ones come first, completed last (lines 75–79).
- `isCurrent` is the first non-completed course (lines 68–73); all other non-completed courses are `locked` (line 99) — so on this screen the asterisk cover only ever renders for the single "current" course; everything else shows a lock or check icon (see §2 below).

### Nested course route (exercises within one course)
- **File:** `/workspaces/learn-p5/src/app/learn/[course]/index.tsx`
- This screen does NOT use `ExerciseCard`. It renders a hero "Next exercise" block (lines 218–269), an "Up Next" list of `lessonRow` Pressables with `MaterialCommunityIcons` (`play-circle-outline` / `lock` / `trophy`) at lines 286–361, and a "Completed" list at lines 364–406. No asterisk, no cover graphics — only vector icons.

## 2. The default asterisk placeholder fallback

- **File:** `/workspaces/learn-p5/src/components/ExerciseCard.tsx`
- **Asterisk SVG path defined:** lines 8–9 (a single hardcoded `Path` string — `asteriskPath`).
- **Rendering of the icon container:** lines 44–54:
  ```tsx
  <View style={[styles.iconContainer, { backgroundColor: derivedColors.primary + "1A" }]}>
    {locked ? (
      <MaterialCommunityIcons name="lock" size={28} color={colors.textSecondary} />
    ) : completed ? (
      <MaterialCommunityIcons name="check-circle" size={28} color={derivedColors.primary} />
    ) : (
      <Svg width={48} height={48} viewBox="0 0 28 28" fill="none">
        <Path d={asteriskPath} fill={derivedColors.primary} />
      </Svg>
    )}
  </View>
  ```
- The asterisk is the **else** fallback (not locked, not completed) — i.e. the "current/available" state. It is a static single-color SVG filled with `derivedColors.primary`. There is **no cover image / emoji / per-module graphic anywhere**; the asterisk is unconditional for the current state.
- The container is styled at line 82–86 (`iconContainer`, `paddingVertical: 40`) — a large square "cover" area above the text content. This is the tile region a real cover graphic would replace.
